headline: Anduril and Qualcomm Partner to Develop US-Made Laptops
summary: Defense technology contractor Anduril and semiconductor designer Qualcomm have entered a partnership to produce a new line of laptops manufactured in the United States.
why: Anduril is an emerging defense-tech company, while Qualcomm produces mobile and PC processors seeking to expand onshore hardware capabilities.

impacts.name: Qualcomm Inc
impacts.why: Collaboration opens defense and secure domestic PC device channels for Qualcomm's processors.
